name.en: Chinese Union Version with New Punctuation (Simplified, “Shen” edition)

edition: Wording of the 1919 Chinese Union Version (和合本), with the 1988 new punctuation (新标点). God is written 神, preceded by the traditional honorific full-width space (　神).

license.statement: eBible.org lists 新标点和合本 Chinese Union Version (simplified) as Public Domain.

notExcluded: This is not the Revised Chinese Union Version (和合本修订版, 2010), which is copyrighted.
modifications: None to wording. USFM markup removed; footnotes moved to notes; translator-supplied words (\add) and proper-name marks (\pn) kept as styling.
